'''March 2004 Franklin tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 20 March 2004 at Outer Limits, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee.<ref name="pcf-2860-41383">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41383#41383 Tennessee tournaments], drunkewok, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 March 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227224003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41433%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was an open-format event of four games starting at 1 pm, with about $5 collected for prize support, and was listed with Decipher as tournament 43144.<ref name="pcf-2860-41383" /> It was run by a player who posted as drunkewok and signed his posts "justin"; [[Royce Russell]] was to run the next event at the store on 17 April 2004.<ref name="pcf-2860-41433">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41433#41433 Tennessee tournaments], drunkewok, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 March 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227224003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41433%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Decklists were not required.<ref name="pcf-2860-42820">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=42820#42820 Tennessee tournaments], drunkewok, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 March 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227224003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41433%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

Twelve or thirteen people came, but only nine started the tournament, and Russell believed that nine finished. A few extra sets of virtual cards were on hand for players who could not print their own. The organizers planned a tournament every third Saturday through the summer, at $5 entry including prizes for everyone.<ref name="pcf-2860-43588">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=43588#43588 Tennessee tournaments], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 March 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227224003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=41433%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Outer Limits, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="pcf-2860-41383" />
* '''Dates:''' 20 March 2004<ref name="pcf-2860-41383" />
* '''Format:''' open, four games<ref name="pcf-2860-41383" />
* '''Players:''' 9<ref name="pcf-2860-43588" />
